configs.biome: Ultracite's core preset, extended by absolute path
configs.eslint raw: Ultracite's core + react presets, inline config ignored (noInlineConfig); the corpus run keeps only the four focus rules
configs.eslint reported: the same, with the file's own disable comments honoured
configs.oxlint default: the root config `ultracite init` writes for core + react
configs.oxlint js-plugins: the same with js-plugins (jsPlugins and settings re-declared on the root)
